title: Checkpoint: timed fix-and-verify
prompt:
Set **7 minutes**. The method should return the **median** element of an ODD-length array (the middle element of the sorted order — find it without changing the caller's array order). It fails on arrays where the answer sits after a descending pair. Find, fix, verify.

Afterward: log target vs actual and name the phase that ate the time.

tests.name: median verified
tests.hint: Copy first, sort the copy, index length/2. The bug shown is actually FIXED — verify it passes, then that IS the exercise.
